SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sachie's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Hong Kong One hundred years ago, there was a Dai Pai Dong, or street food stall, on every Hong Kong street corner, serving up super fast, mouthwatering, and affordable meals.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sachie's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Coromandel Tane comes from the sea with a bag of kai moana. He pulls out a bottle of kombucha and offers it to Sachie, telling her it is made from seaweed. Sachie and Tane collect seaweed.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Marcus In The Med: Mallorca
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Lazy Breakfasts Marcus wants to discover unique Mallorcan breakfasts and he begins his search at Mistral, the first cafe on the island to roast their own coffee.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Feast By Fire
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Fire & Fat Jess travels to Burnt Bean Co, where the pork chop gets the full BBQ treatment. She then returns home to demonstrate her own version, revealing how to keep the meat juicy, build flavour, and nail the perfect finish on a cut anyone can find.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Thai Street Food: Best Kept Secrets
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Khanom Wan Experience the streets of Thailand through the eyes of the sellers making some of the country's oldest and most traditional desserts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Global Soul Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Black Eyed Pea Biryani Chef Deborah VanTrece brings together Southern and Indian flavours with her black-eyed pea biryani.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Donal's Feasts, Fasts And Festivals
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Donal joins a Muslim family who are fasting during Ramadan, explores the traditions of the Romanian Orthodox Community as he prepares a traditional Easter meal and joins in the atmosphere of Diwali.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Inside Sydney Fish Market
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Under The Pump Seven weeks after opening, the new Sydney Fish Market faces its first Good Friday as fuel costs, wild weather and an auction failure threaten Easter supplies.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Thailand And Malaysia Rick takes a train to Phuket to learn the art of hot and sour tom yum goong, the culinary icon of Thailand. Later he meets up with one of his cooking heroes, David Thompson.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E5 Cuba's Savory Secrets In search of Cuba's most authentic and delicious ingredients, Gordon embraces local ingenuity as he fishes and forages his way across the island.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Ainsley's Taste Of Malta
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Central Ainsley is in central Malta where he starts his day exploring the beautiful ancient city of Mdina. After a tour of the city, Ainsley stops by a restaurant with an impressive history and a great view.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eater's Guide To The World
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Dining Alone In The Pacific Northwest Join narrator Maya Rudolph in the Pacific Northwest and explore the best part of dining solo-not having to share any of the juicy pork steak, soba noodles, and piping hot fried chicken.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E29 The Ranch Eduardo Valseca is taken hostage in an orchestrated abduction; Keith Morrison reflects on the family he spent years following; what happened to them might have destroyed many, but not the Valsecas.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E30 What Happened to Amy? For more than 30 years, Ohio investigators have searched for answers in the murder of 10-year-old Amy Mihaljevic; the details of the case still haunt Josh Mankiewicz and investigators, who ask for help solving the crime.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E31 The Secret of Spirit Lake An advocate for missing and murdered Indigenous women searches for answers in the disappearance of her niece and exposes cracks in law enforcement; Andrea Canning looks back on this important story, one that became her passion project.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E32 The Plan A double homicide in upstate New York leads detectives on a cross-country investigation; Dennis Murphy reflects on a story full of twists and turns, including the surprising suspect at the center.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E33 The Haunting The children of an Oklahoma pastor survive the robbery that took their parents' lives; it's a story Keith Morrison still can't forget, and one where the very best and worst of humanity are both on full display.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E34 Internal Affairs When a popular graduate student is shot dead in Durham, N.C., detectives uncover a deadly love triangle; it takes a lot to surprise correspondent Josh Mankiewicz, but the claims are shocking.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E35 Return to Manitowoc County It's a mystery that defies easy answers, and "Dateline" has been following it for more than a decade; Steven Avery and his teenage nephew were convicted of killing Teresa Halbach; now, Andrea Canning shares her insight into the controversial case.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E36 Twisted When an Iowa woman is attacked while home alone with her three children, the confrontation turns deadly; Dennis Murphy examines one of the most sophisticated criminal plots of his "Dateline" career.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E01 A Deadly Thanksgiving A deranged shooter attacks a family Thanksgiving dinner, leaving four dead and even more wounded, setting off a massive holiday-season manhunt to catch the killer - before they can strike again.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E01 Thanks-killing Earl and Terry Robertson are found brutally murdered in their home just before Thanksgiving; investigating whether this is a holiday robbery gone terribly wrong, or a crime committed by someone the couple knew and trusted.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S08 E18 What Happened in Vegas Part 1 A chance encounter on the Pacific Coast Highway with a woman he first spoke to in a jail cell leads Keith Morrison to reexamine the mysterious death of Las Vegas casino magnate Ted Binion.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S08 E19 What Happened in Vegas Part 2 A chance encounter on the Pacific Coast Highway with a woman he first spoke to in a jail cell leads Keith Morrison to reexamine the mysterious death of Las Vegas casino magnate Ted Binion.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E128 The Disappearance of Debbie Hawk Debbie Hawk's three children arrive home to find their mother missing, with blood throughout the house; investigating who did this and why.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E06 Twice as Deadly A young mother in the quiet Atlanta hamlet of Buford is found shot to death in what detectives deem to be a staged suicide; as investigators search for leads, they uncover an eerily similar death linked to someone with close ties to both victims.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E11 Search for a Monster Atlanta's tight-knit Chinatown community is devastated when a beloved mother is discovered brutally murdered in an industrial parking lot; with few leads, the team discovers a cryptic note that leads them to a surprising killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E01 Officer Down When an officer is gunned down during a routine traffic stop, detectives work to bring justice to their fallen comrade; the team races against the clock to find the killer before he strikes again.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E02 When The Music Stops When an aspiring rapper is found dead during a shootout at the Metropolitan Studios in Atlanta, detectives must follow a trail of lies, ultimately discovering a cold-blooded betrayal at the heart of the murder.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E03 The Star Recruit When a 17-year-old military recruit and homecoming queen is gunned down outside her home, the community is stunned; but as detectives look closer into those around her, they uncover a complex web of relationships that may lead to her killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E04 Murder on Welcome All Road When a veteran is found dead in the back of a pickup truck in Southwest Atlanta, investigators must untangle a web of secrets that leads straight to a suspect with close ties to the victim.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E05 Halloween Horror After a young woman finds a human foot on her porch the night before Halloween, detectives race to identify the scattered remains and uncover a killer who'll do anything to bury the truth.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E06 A Mother's Nightmare When a beloved member of the Covington church community discovers her son murdered inside their home, everyone is shocked.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E08 Lost & Found When a devoted mother vanishes on the 10th anniversary of her cousin's disappearance, detectives race against the clock to untangle a set of mysterious clues culminating in an undercover operation to find the missing mom.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E10 Horror at the Mall A 28-year-old mother vanishes without a trace, only to turn up murdered and left at an Atlanta area mall; when DNA points to a suspect who's never met her, investigators must look beyond the physical evidence to uncover an even deeper mystery.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Real Murders of Atlanta
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E09 The Brother's Keeper The brutal murders of two Atlanta brothers leave detectives searching for a dangerous predator. But as the investigation unfolds, every assumption is challenged until an unimaginable betrayal comes to light.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S11 E28 The Family Secret It is common for long-haul truck driver Lloyd Ford to be gone for stretches, and when he disappears, it doesn't raise many flags; at least two people know where he is, and they guard the secret for 27 years, but the truth is about to be revealed.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S11 E24 A Family's Story Two years after the disappearance of his wife, Josh Powell kills his two sons and himself.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E01 Kimberly Warth When Las Vegas Police respond to a self-defense shooting, the case appears open and shut; following the discovery of bombshell video evidence that contradicts the shooter's initial story, a mother's desperation for him.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E02 Cynthia Cdebaca When a California man is found riddled with bullets in his own home, the investigation leads to an unconventional suspect close to the victim; a bizarre interrogation leaves a daughter heartbroken by the actions her mother took to protect her.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E03 Kelly Turner When a Colorado mother claims her daughter is mysteriously ill, doctors question if they have a Munchausen by proxy case; the investigation reveals the horrific truth behind the lengths a mother is willing to go with her child's life for attention.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dirty Rotten Scandals ᴺᵉʷ
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E01 The Dr. Phil Show Pt. 1 An investigation uncovers troubling allegations about the long-running hit daytime series "The Dr. Phil Show" while former show guests reveal shocking behind-the-scenes experiences of coercion and humiliation.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dirty Rotten Scandals ᴺᵉʷ
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E02 The Dr. Phil Show Pt. 2 The investigation continues, as suspicious relationships emerge between The Dr. Phil Show and its preferred treatment facilities; one family's trust in televised help leads to years of suffering.

oxygenwest.us.title: Catfish Murders
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E03 The Hometown Hero When a promising young boxer is found murdered after arranging a date on Facebook, detectives follow his digital trail and uncover a sinister deception that suggests he may not have been the only target.

oxygenwest.us.title: Catfish Murders
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E02 A Hopeless Romantic A young mother, with dreams of settling down, finally finds love online; her hopes for a romantic Valentine's Day take a terrifying turn when she's lured into a deadly trap, masterminded by a self-styled cult leader.

oxygenwest.us.title: Catfish Murders
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E01 A Killer Profile When an Arizona corrections officer vanishes after leaving for a hot date, investigators uncover blood in the desert, a digital phantom named Paige, and a predator lurking in plain sight.

oxygenwest.us.description: S08 E20 Lone Star Obsession Part 1 When a pathologist is found murdered in his home, the investigation reveals simmering jealousies and a love triangle.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S05 E20 The Vow Two sisters determined to fulfill a promise investigate the mystery surrounding their mother's death.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E02 12 Minutes on Elm Street Byron Smith claims he shot two teenagers in self-defense when they broke into his home on Thanksgiving Day, but investigators suspect there's more to his story.

oxygenwest.us.title: The Hooters Murders: Deadly Shift
oxygenwest.us.description: As Hooters reached its peak in the 2000s, several women who worked at Hooters were targeted by predators and murdered in cold blood; a look at how women who worked at the iconic restaurant chain were preyed upon.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E01 Beloved Veteran Kelly and the team help the Lake Station Police department look into the 2007 slaying of a kind-hearted WWII veteran killed with a sledgehammer; tracing the purchases on his stolen credit card may be the key to solving the case.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E02 Silenced The team helps the Abilene Police Department investigate the heartbreaking double homicide of a devoted mother and her young daughter strangled in their home; DNA evidence left at the scene might help identify their killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Cold Justice
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E03 Killer at the Door Kelly and Steve join the Kankakee Police Department to help a woman who just missed seeing her mother's killer at their front door when she was 11 years old; decades later, efforts are made to recall any clues to help crack the case.

syfy.us.title: Old
syfy.us.description: A vacationing family discovers that the secluded beach where they're relaxing for a few hours is somehow causing them to age rapidly, reducing their entire lives into a single day. (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Mystery) - 2021

syfy.us.title: Tombstone
syfy.us.description: Wyatt Earp and his brothers, Morgan and Virgil, have left their gunslinger ways behind them to settle down and start a business in the town of Tombstone, Ariz. While they aren't looking to find trouble, trouble soon finds them when they become targets of the ruthless Cowboy gang. Now, together with Wyatt's best friend, Doc Holliday, the brothers pick up their guns once more to restore order to a lawless land. (Western, Action) - 1993

syfy.us.title: Godzilla
syfy.us.description: During a nuclear test, the French government inadvertently mutates a lizard nest; years later, a giant lizard makes its way to New York City. Dr. Niko Tatopoulos, an expert on the effects of radiation on animals, is sent by the U.S. government to study the beast. When the creature, dubbed "Godzilla" by news outlets, emerges, a massive battle with the military begins. To make matters worse, Niko discovers that Godzilla has laid a nest of 200 eggs, which are ready to hatch. (Science fiction, Action) - 1998

syfy.us.title: The 355
syfy.us.description: CIA agent Mason "Mace" Brown joins forces with a rival German agent, a cutting-edge computer specialist and a Colombian psychologist when a top-secret weapon falls into the hands of a group of mercenaries. Together, the four women embark on a breakneck mission to save the world while staying one step ahead of a mysterious figure who's tracking their every move. (Action, Thriller) - 2022

The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

Captain Jones does not care about politics, but the earnest Professor and his supporters win him over to their cause, and they try to thwart the Communists' plans. (Adventure) - 1954

Ambitious to a fault, Carlisle abandons Zeena and the carny to reinvent himself as The Great Stanton, wowing high-class audiences in a Chicago hotel. (Crime drama) - 1947

5starmax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
5starmax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
5starmax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

5starmax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
5starmax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

5starmax.us.title: Batman
5starmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Batman Returns
5starmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Batman Forever
5starmax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Batman & Robin
5starmax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

5starmax.us.title: Working Girls
5starmax.us.description: College graduate Molly (Louise Smith), trying to bankroll her own business, works as a high-priced New York City escort. As a lesbian, she's able to keep her emotional distance from the clients, who range from cynically exploitative to desperately needy. But her open ambition to rise above her current station rubs many of her coworkers the wrong way, especially the combative, street-smart Dawn (Amanda Goodwin) and the escort service's disdainful madam, Lucy (Ellen McElduff). (Drama) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
5starmax.us.description: Stressed by adolescence, 16-year-old Craig Gilner (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a mental-health clinic. Unfortunately, the youth wing is closed, so he must spend his mandated five-day stay with adults. One of them, Bobby (Zach Galifianakis), quickly becomes his mentor -- and protégé, while Craig finds himself drawn to a fellow teen, Noelle (Emma Roberts), who just may be the cure he needs to forget an unrequited crush. (Comedy drama) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
5starmax.us.description: Enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives on the doorstep of a harried mother, Isabel Green, who is trying to raise her kids and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war. Isabel has her hands full of not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons. (Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Despicable Me
5starmax.us.description: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
5starmax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
5starmax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Hall Pass
5starmax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
5starmax.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
5starmax.us.description: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
5starmax.us.description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1998

5starmax.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
5starmax.us.description: Internet users watch six collegians as they spend the night in Michael Myers' (Brad Loree) childhood home. - 2002

5starmax.us.title: Open Water
5starmax.us.description: Scuba divers (Blanchard Ryan, Daniel Travis) struggle to survive in shark-infested waters after their tour boat accidentally leaves them behind. - 2003

5starmax.us.title: Mississippi Masala
5starmax.us.description: People resent the romance of a black man (Denzel Washington) and an Indian woman (Sarita Choudhury) in a Mississippi town. - 1991

5starmax.us.title: MacGruber
5starmax.us.description: After his sworn enemy steals a nuclear warhead, a clueless soldier-of-fortune (Will Forte) leads a skilled team on a mission to retrieve the device and bring the thief to justice. - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's 11
5starmax.us.description: Veterans of the 82nd Airborne Division devise an elaborate plot to simultaneously rob five casinos on New Year's Eve. - 1960

5starmax.us.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
5starmax.us.description: With the sitter dead, a Los Angeles teen (Christina Applegate) lands a job in the fashion industry to feed her siblings. - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Gimme Shelter
5starmax.us.description: Filmmakers Albert Maysles, David Maysles and Charlotte Zwerin show the Rolling Stones' 1969 California concert. - 1970

5starmax.us.title: Take the Lead
5starmax.us.description: Renowned ballroom dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a job at a New York City public school and helps his students meld hip-hop and classical styles to create a dance form. - 2006

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Monster
bbcamerica.us.description: Opponents of Adam Schiff question the handling of a sexual-assault case by the police and the D.A.'s office.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Cherished
bbcamerica.us.description: The investigation into a girl's death reveals secrets the adoptive family was desperately trying to hide.

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - DWB
bbcamerica.us.description: Detectives discover a shocking twist involving unlikely suspects when they investigate the brutal beating of a black man dumped near the highway.

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth - Seasonal Forests
bbcamerica.us.description: The trees of the Taiga forest; giant sequoia, the largest living thing on the planet.

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Frozen Planet - The Epic Journey
bbcamerica.us.description: The highlights from the series; a view of the entire polar year from winter through summer.

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Frozen Planet - Summer
bbcamerica.us.description: It is high summer in the polar regions, and the sun never sets; many species take advantage of the easier conditions, but summer is a tough time for the polar bear family, as their ice world melts away and the cubs take their first swimming lesson.

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Frozen Planet - To the Ends of the Earth
bbcamerica.us.description: David Attenborough travels from the Arctic to the Antarctic to discover magical new ice worlds inhabited by the most extraordinary animal survivors on earth.

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Frozen Planet - Autumn
bbcamerica.us.description: Polar landscapes in autumn are transformed as the big freeze returns; in the Arctic, polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast to wait for the return of the ice; off the coast 2,000 beluga whales head for a special estuary.

bbcearth.us.title: Nature's Miracle Orphans
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E03 Santino & Shelley An orphaned baby monkey must find his place in a troop; Lucy helps a cheetah learn to hunt before she can be released back to the wild.

bbcearth.us.title: Nature's Miracle Orphans
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E04 Manji & Mandi An orphaned baby rhino learns how to be wild before he can be released; a baby tapir looks for a new family.

bbcearth.us.title: The Bear Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Spring Gordon Buchanan must overcome his own fear, black bears have a dangerous reputation and attack more people than any other bear in the world, but once he meets Lily, a tolerant bear, mother of Hope, Gordon feels heartbroken.

bbcearth.us.title: The Bear Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Summer Summer arrives and Gordon finds out that Tiny the bear cub has been abandoned by her mother.

bbcearth.us.title: The Bear Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Autumn It is autumn and Gordon finds out that Hope is back with her mother.

bbcearth.us.title: Cheetah Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Following two cheetah mothers -- Savannah and her four cubs, in the Tswalu Kalahari Reserve, and Chili and her five kittens in the Great Karoo Wilderness -- as they navigate a harsh environment, dangerous wildlife and dwindling prey.

bbcearth.us.title: Cheetah Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Wildlife filmmaker Gordon Buchanan gets close to wild cheetah in the Kalahari, experiencing first-hand the very real dangers these big cats face.

bbcearth.us.title: Gorilla Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Battle of the Silverbacks Gordon Buchanan realizes a lifelong dream by gaining the trust of a family of rare Grauer's Gorillas, the largest primates on Earth.

bbcearth.us.title: Gorilla Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Facing a New Threat Gordon Buchanan returns to the Democratic Republic of Congo to discover the fate of his gorilla family.

bbcearth.us.title: Elephant Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Gordon Buchanan tries to gain the trust of an elephant mother and her baby in the Kenyan wilderness, with the help of local expert Benjamin Kyalo.

bbcearth.us.title: Elephant Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Gordon returns to Kenya to follow baby elephant Wiva and her family in the height of the dry season; a new baby, Gawa, is born creating an extraordinary celebration.

bbcearth.us.title: Chimp Family Fortunes
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Clan leader Freud, his brother Frodo, and popular female Gremlin are all members of a wild chimpanzee clan who live in a tropical jungle in Tanzania.

bbcearth.us.title: Chimp Family Fortunes
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 While gentle female Gremlin struggles to raise her young twins, their father Frodo hides from the other male chimps who are out to get him.

bbcearth.us.title: Chimp Family Fortunes
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Frodo makes a dramatic appearance while the clan are out hunting, and cocky young Sheldon causes a stir among the males.

bbcearth.us.title: Chimp Family Fortunes
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E04 The lost young twins run into a band of marauding baboons and are terrified. Will they ever see their mum Gremlin again?

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Stretched to the Limit
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Animals appear to have stretched their natural gifts to the limits, including giraffes and chameleons.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : A Curious Hoax?
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Curiosities lead to accusations of forgery.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Young Wrinklies
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Sir David Attenborough looks at some amazing quirks of evolution; he encounters two examples where nature has tinkered with the aging process.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : A Curious Twist
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E04 David Attenborough looks at the tusk of the narwhal and the spiral shells found on snails and ammonites.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Seeing The Pattern
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E05 Beautifully patterned or brightly colored animals attract the attention of collectors.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Virgin Births
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E01 Female Komodo dragons can reproduce without contact with a male; female aphids can clone themselves to produce copies.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Armoured Animals
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E02 Rhinos and hedgehogs protect themselves with body armor in the form of thick skin.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Life in the Dark
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E03 Animals adapt to life in the dark; owl eyes are too large to move within their sockets; the giant squid has the largest eyes in the animal kingdom.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Imposters
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E04 Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on amazing animals; he looks at cuckoos and the way the death's-head hawkmoth steals honey.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Bad Reputations
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E05 Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on nature's most amazing animals; he takes a closer look at the vampire bat.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Shocking Senses
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E06 How naturalists find out that some eels are electric is revealed.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Life on Ice
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E07 Sir David Attenborough shines the spotlight on the wood frog, which freezes solid; he looks at how the emperor penguin breeds.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Spinners and Weavers
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E08 Nature produces two unique mechanisms of natural construction; weaving in birds and silk fascinate scientists.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Strange Parents
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E09 David Attenborough shines the spotlight on female hyenas; he examines why male seahorses give birth.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Magical Appearances
bbcearth.us.description: The disappearance of some animals each year puzzled early naturalists; the question arises whether swallows hibernate in mud or underwater and the sudden appearance of butterflies each spring was also a mystery.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Impossible Feats
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E01 David Attenborough examines how fleas jump; he tracks the true speed of a cheetah.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Minds
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E02 David Attenborough examines orangutans and crows, two unusual animals that use tools.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Expandable Bodies
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E03 David Attenborough examines creatures that have fascinated people for centuries; he looks at the expandable bodies of anacondas and camels.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Feeders
bbcearth.us.description: S03 E04 A look at some species with unusual styles of consuming food, including the gigantic blue whales and the flamboyant flamingos.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Cures
bbcearth.us.description: Humans are not alone in using medicines against injuries and infection and some animals protect themselves with natural remedies in extraordinary ways.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Remarkable Regeneration
bbcearth.us.description: A look at the animals who can regenerate entire parts of their bodies.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Animal Frankensteins
bbcearth.us.description: S04 E01 Sir David Attenborough examines bizarre and deadly hybrid animals.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Finding the Way
bbcearth.us.description: S04 E02 Sir David Attenborough examines animals with the ability to find their way.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Extreme Babies
bbcearth.us.description: S04 E03 Sir David Attenborough examines the sizes of animals' young.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Curious Counters
bbcearth.us.description: S04 E04 Sir David Attenborough discovers if animals and plants can count.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Incredible Shells
bbcearth.us.description: S04 E05 Sir David Attenborough investigates two shells that win at evolution.

bbcearth.us.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities : Ferocious Fighters
bbcearth.us.description: S04 E06 Sir David Attenborough explores animals with fighting behavior.

bbcearth.us.title: Seasonal Wonderlands
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 New England New England is the stage for the most incredible color change on earth, when the vivid greens of summer give way to the golds and reds of autumn.

bbcearth.us.title: Seasonal Wonderlands
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Svalbard Svalbard in the Arctic spends many months of the year in complete darkness, an unrelenting frozen winter with temperatures down to 40 below Celsius.

bbcearth.us.title: Seasonal Wonderlands
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Okavango The Okavango Delta is a lush wetland of islands and lagoons in the middle of the vast, featureless Kalahari Desert.

bbcearth.us.title: Big Bear Diary
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Follow the trials and tribulations of North America's bears as they struggle to survive in an increasingly hostile world.

bbcearth.us.title: Big Bear Diary
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 The conflict between black bear mothers Jeannie and Katie continue as Jeannie besieges Katie's two cubs in a tree; Brown bear mother Blondie and her three cubs make the most of carrion washed up by the sea.

bbcearth.us.title: Big Bear Diary
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Brown bear mum Blondie and her cubs were last seen fleeing from a pack of wolves. Have they survived? Both the black and polar bear families have trouble with marauding males.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Bread The miracle of yeast helps Raymond to create a French classic: brioche; he gets down to basics with a French country bread recipe that's essential for any baker to add to their repertoire; lastly, he makes a spectacular apple croustade.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E02 Cakes and Pastries Chef Raymond begins with a feather-light lemon tea cake, coated in an apricot jam and tangy lemon glaze; he also makes a choux pastry filled with chocolate cream and covered with a chocolate icing; lastly, the secrets to the perfect macarons.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E03 Lamb Chef Blanc shares his favorite lamb dishes: lamb liver with caramelized potatoes and French seasoning, a slow-roasted garlic and herb lamb shoulder with potato and turnip gratin and lamb Provencal with ratatouille.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Pudding Raymond celebrates his passion for puddings, cooking dishes including riz au lait, tarte tatin and fruit crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Leftovers Nigel starts off with the remains of the Sunday roast.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Winter Warmers Nigel makes comfort foods that hit the spot.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E01 New Tricks Nigel transforms classic recipes with some new twists.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Too Good to Waste How to make simple, delicious feasts from ingredients that seem to have seen better days.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Nigella introduces her love of Italian food through a spectacular yet simple Sicilian pasta with tomatoes, garlic and almonds and a mid-week family feast of tagliata.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Nigella Lawson shares the secrets of her Italian roast chicken, served alongside a saffron orzotto; Nigella prepares coffee ice cream for dessert, inspired by the ice cream parlors of Florence; a chocolate olive oil cake provides an extra treat.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Episode 3 Pork loin stuffed with Parma ham and oregano, served alongside her speedy mock mash and lazy person's vignarola.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Liquorice pudding; Sardinian sun-dried and toasted couscous; butterflied leg of lamb; baby aubergines with oregano and roasted red onion.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Nigella starts with her take on a light and sunny yogurt pot cake; she recruits her niece and nephew to make a shortcut sausage meatball supper; Nigella prepares squid and prawns with marjoram and chili; a tiramisu ends the evening.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Episode 6 Lamb chops with mint; chilli and golden potatoes; ruby red plum and amoretti crumble; farro risotto with mushrooms.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E01 Shellfish Chef Blanc celebrates the best of British shellfish as he cooks dishes including Moules Marinière, seared squid salad and Scottish lobster.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E02 Cakes and Pastries Chef Raymond begins with a feather-light lemon tea cake, coated in an apricot jam and tangy lemon glaze; he also makes a choux pastry filled with chocolate cream and covered with a chocolate icing; lastly, the secrets to the perfect macarons.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E03 Lamb Chef Blanc shares his favorite lamb dishes: lamb liver with caramelized potatoes and French seasoning, a slow-roasted garlic and herb lamb shoulder with potato and turnip gratin and lamb Provencal with ratatouille.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Pudding Raymond celebrates his passion for puddings, cooking dishes including riz au lait, tarte tatin and fruit crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E05 Charcuterie Chef Raymond shares his love of charcuterie, beginning with thin slices of duck cured in herbs and juniper berries; also, he makes a chicken liver parfait and a meaty pot-au-feu medley; lastly, a ham hock terrine served with home-made pickles.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E06 Spices and Chillies Drawing upon his travels through Asia, Raymond creates dishes full of fragrant spice and fiery heat.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E07 Summer Fruits Raymond demonstrates the versatility of the summer's juiciest fruits with a simple but impressive berry-strewn pavlova and a spicy cherry clafoutis where the vibrant fruit is cushioned in a bed of soft, sumptuous pastry.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E08 Summer Greens Raymond celebrates the freshest summer greens, beginning with a simple yet vibrant pistou soup, laden with summer vegetables and bursting with basil, topped with crispy croutons and meltingly rich Parmesan.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Nisha's family helps her cook chicken dhansak and a Hungarian favorite.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Nisha cooks chicken korma and marinated tandoori monkfish tail on the BBQ.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Nisha cooks a traditional monsoon mushroom curry with grapes and tasty barbecued corn.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Nisha Katona cooks salmon and tomato curry, and eggplant curry with fresh roti.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Nisha cooks oxtail and shin curry, spiced barbecued prawns and banana pudding.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Nisha cooks some Malaysian mussels and ginger biscuit lamb raan.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Nisha cooks meatball curry and tandoori chops with turmeric chips.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Nisha cooks egg and cauliflower curry and some Hungarian plum dumplings.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E09 Nisha cooks Bengali fish in banana leaves and a big roasted rib of beef.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E10 Nisha cooks chicken and apricot biryani and fish finger sandwiches.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Suffolk and Naples Rick celebrates the abundance of seafood and the rich, colorful sauces of Naples.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 India and Cornwall Rick catches turbot off the Cornish coast and cooks it with cider and cream.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Spain and Britain Rick's off to Galicia in Spain to sample some rare shellfish.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 India and America A spicy shark vindaloo and the making of an authentic dhal with lentils.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Australia and Italy Seafood king Rick travels to Queensland, Australia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 America and Cornwall Chesapeake Bay in the U.S., cooking traditional oyster dishes.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Thailand and Cornwall Rick goes to Hua Hin in Thailand, where he spends time in local markets talking to locals about various types of food; in Cornwall, he fries fish and jazzes it up with red curry and steamed jasmine rice.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 America and Yorkshire Rick visits America, Naples and the UK in Whitby, with good old English fish and chips in the final episode.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Sweet and Sour Nigel Slater shows us how to prepare five different sweet and sour dishes.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Fish and Meat Nigel continues to explore successful food marriages in the kitchen.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Spicy and Cool Nigel Slater shows us how to mix spicy flavors with something cooling.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Soft and Crisp Nigel Slater continues his exploration of brilliant culinary combinations.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Sugar and Spice Nigel shows a classic cinnamon, ginger and plum cake and demonstrates the unexpected such as sticky ribs and a spicy lentil stew with caramelized onions.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Born and Bred Nigel transforms everyday suppers, including a dish of baked mushrooms and chestnuts and a home-grown pud of blackberry and fig pie.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Kolkata and Chennai Rick explores Bengal and Tamil Nadu, the regions that began Britain's love affair with curry; Rick enjoys the prominence of fish and seafood in their dishes, flavored with mustard in Kolkata and tamarind in Chennai.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Mumbai and Pondicherry Rick explores Mumbai in search of the bombil, the fish that immortalized Bombay Duck; enjoying Parsee hospitality.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Lucknow and Punjab Rick Stein arrives in the cultural city of Lucknow, India; it is reputed to be the curry capital of India.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rajasthan and Himachal Pradesh Rick Stein visits the royal state of Rajasthan, a land of kings, hilltop forts and palaces, where the local population are serious meat-eaters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

hdnetmovies.us.title: Comes a Horseman
hdnetmovies.us.description: Determined single woman Ella Connors (Jane Fonda) struggles to maintain her ranch despite constant attempts by Jacob "J.W." Ewing (Jason Robards), the aging owner of the neighboring ranch, to coerce her into selling. When oil companies begin pressuring both ranchers to allow drilling, Ella's position becomes even more perilous. Though Ella thinks she's scrappy enough to fight them on her own, her chances get better with the arrival of hunky war veteran Frank "Buck" Athearn (James Caan). (Western) - 1978

hdnetmovies.us.title: Ride in the Whirlwind
hdnetmovies.us.description: Cowboys Wes (Jack Nicholson), Vern (Cameron Mitchell) and Otis (Tom Filer) are journeying through Texas when they have the unfortunate luck of meeting a gang of robbers who have just held up a stagecoach and lynched the driver. The local sheriff's posse surrounds them before they can get away, and Wes and his friends are unable to convince the lawmen they're not part of the gang. After a fierce shootout, Wes and Vern flee -- with the vigilante sheriff hot on their trail. (Western) - 1965

hdnetmovies.us.title: Support Your Local Sheriff
hdnetmovies.us.description: A small-scale gold rush erupts in a Colorado town after treasure is found in a grave. The area quickly becomes a magnet for criminals and other ne'er-do-wells, but everyone is too intent on searching for gold to consider law and order. When Jason McCullough (James Garner), a clever and supremely laid-back gunslinger, wanders into town, he becomes the de facto lawman, aided by local eccentric Jake (Jack Elam). McCullough's ingenuity is tested, however, when he runs afoul of the tough Danby gang. (Western, Comedy) - 1969

hdnetmovies.us.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
hdnetmovies.us.description: When traveling con man Latigo Smith (James Garner) drifts into a small Western town, he decides to take advantage of a local rivalry between gold-mining factions. Recruiting the shifty Jug May (Jack Elam) to pose as a notorious gunfighter, Smith sets his scheme in motion, while also taking time to romance the lovely Patience Barton (Suzanne Pleshette). However, after his ruse is uncovered, Smith incurs the wrath of the real hired gun, among others, leading to a big shoot-out. (Western, Comedy) - 1971

hdnetmovies.us.title: Sam Whiskey
hdnetmovies.us.description: Great gambler Sam Whiskey (Burt Reynolds) has got his hands on a heist job that's pretty outrageous, even by Wild West standards. A drop-dead-gorgeous woman (Angie Dickinson) wants to quietly give back the gold her husband had stolen, now that he's dead. She approaches Sam to retrieve the gold from the bottom of a river and smuggle it back into the mint. The widow's beauty, and the nice sum she promises him, leave Sam powerless to resist the preposterous proposal. (Western, Comedy) - 1969

hdnetmovies.us.title: Battle of Britain
hdnetmovies.us.description: At a seminal moment in World War II, British Air Chief Marshal Sir Hugh Dowding (Laurence Olivier) must rally his outnumbered pilots against Hitler's feared Luftwaffe. Besieged by German bombing runs, the Brits counter with an aggressive air campaign of their own. Within months, the Nazis find themselves on the run, thanks to Dowding's tactical genius and the work of talented squadron leaders (Michael Caine, Christopher Plummer) and other brave patriots. (War, Action, Drama) - 1969

retroplex.us.title: Chappaquiddick
retroplex.us.description: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious events forever alters his political legacy and changes the course of presidential history. (Thriller, Historical drama) - 2017

A pair of screenwriters (Donald Faison, Keith Nobbs) across the hall keep bugging him for help. The superintendent of his building (Luis Guzmán) is stabbed by hoodlums hired by his own rebellious daughter (Melonie Diaz). To top it off, a sexually aggressive chiropractor (Elizabeth Hurley) may just be Ray's undoing. (Comedy) - 2001

To the dismay of the government, Courbet approves a reality show that will become network television's first foray into snuff. In the first episode, contestants engage in a deadly game of Russian roulette for the chance at a multi-million-dollar cash prize. (Comedy drama) - 2007

retroplex.us.title: After Dark, My Sweet

When crooked Uncle Bud (Bruce Dern) joins the two, Fay's darker side begins to appear. Bud and Fay concoct a scheme to kidnap the son of a local wealthy family and have Collie carry out the dirty work, to which the troubled ex-boxer agrees, but he soon has second thoughts. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho. (Western, Mystery) - 2000

Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. While both Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, the son wants to keep it for himself. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him. (Western) - 1946

Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Susanna Pass

Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps. smithsonianchannel.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska - Fuel's Gold
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Father-son aviators battle turbulence to refuel a remote mine, bush pilots fight an aerial jam to reach Alaska's biggest sled race, and the Coastguard turn a C-130 into a bomber to drop supplies on an isolated beach.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Aerial Australia - The Vast West
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Western Australia is home to colossal gold mines, massive sheep stations, the world's largest shark, a 4x4 trail; it has Perth, the most isolated big city on Earth.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Mummy Mysteries - Killing a King
smithsonianchannel.us.description: The pockmarked mummy of Ramesses V reveals a shocking tale of bitter family infighting, a civil insurrection and a cause of death that ultimately pushed ancient Egypt to the edge of collapse.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Ancient Powers - Law and Order
smithsonianchannel.us.description: In an unruly world, ancient powers must lead their people and quash any rebellion; to achieve this, they may invent caste systems and more.

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece - Secrets of the Acropolis
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Experts uncover the secrets of the Parthenon and of ancient Athens. (History, Documentary) - 2026-07-15

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Scanning History - The Fall of the World's First Empire
smithsonianchannel.us.description: The first great empire of the Akkadians, led by Sargon the Great, dominated the Fertile Crescent, replacing the Sumerians and extending its influence as far north as Syria and south as Oman. (Documentary, Ancient history) - 2025-10-06

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Treasures Decoded - Rome's Secret Weapon
smithsonianchannel.us.description: An archaeological investigation of an ancient Scottish battlefield uncovers a vast array of ballistic weaponry; x-ray scans reveal it came from a secret weapon called a manuballista, the Roman Empire's equivalent of an assault rifle. (Documentary, History) - 2021-08-16

smithsonianchannel.us.title: Disaster: The Chernobyl Meltdown - Cover Up ᴺᵉʷ
smithsonianchannel.us.description: The day after the incident, helicopter crews brave deadly radioactive smoke to extinguish the fire raging in the reactor core; as 50,000 locals evacuate, Soviet authorities try to conceal the scale and human cost of the accident. (Documentary) - 2026-04-25

smithsonianchannel.us.title: World's Most Scenic River Journeys - The Neretva
smithsonianchannel.us.description: Rumoured to be the cleanest river in Europe, few dispute it's the coldest; cascading down from the Dinaric Alps in Serbia, it soon crosses the border into Bosnia-Herzegovina, where marine biologist and fisherman Sanel Riđanović casts for salmon. (Documentary, Travel) - 2022-03-25

(Documentary) - 2024-03-11

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E08 River Raiders A look at riverine warfare from the Civil War to Vietnam and small but powerful combat ships. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E07 The Battle of Leyte Gulf It is considered the largest sea battle in history: the Battle of Leyte Gulf in WWII was three days of ingenious strategy and white-knuckle combat between warships, aircraft and kamikazes. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E03 The Battle of Incheon A portrayal of a crucial September 1950 military operation that helped the UN and ROK gain the upper hand over North Korea in the Korean War. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, War)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S09E02 Tornado An inside look at the Panavia Tornado's evolution from a Cold War low-level bomber to a high-level fighter-interceptor. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S09E01 Lancaster The inside story of the Avro Lancaster, the British bomber that was rushed into service to fight back against Nazi Germany. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S10E03 B-17 Flying Fortress The Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress is one of the most lethal bombers of the U.S. Air Force in WWII's European and Pacific campaigns; among other things, the plane delivered food to the German-occupied Netherlands. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Warriors
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S10E09 Stuka Dive Bomber A look at the rise and fall of the infamous Nazi dive bomber Ju-87 Stuka, an aircraft of World War II. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Military, History)

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E17 Graywater; Small Engines Ways to reduce the amount of water used for irrigation; Richard installs an irrigation system that reuses waste water from a washing machine; toilets with built-in sinks; Roger visits an engine repair shop to learn how to maintain small engines.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E18 Patio Upgrade; Mirror Landscape contractor Roger Cook heads to San Francisco to upgrade a neglected urban patio; the guys ask "What is it?"; Tom shows Kevin how to hang a heavy mirror on a wall.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E19 Fast Hot Water; Chimney Plumbing and heating expert Richard Trethewey installs a recirculation pump to provide hot water quickly to a bathroom; contractor Tom Silva shares a tip for fixing the handle on a casement window; Kevin helps a homeowner line her fireplace chimney.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E20 Vinyl Casing; Dishwasher Kevin O'Connor works with a siding contractor to install a new vinyl window sill and casing with a traditional colonial molding profile; Richard Trethewey helps a homeowner install a new dishwasher.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E21 Texas Plants; New Window Roger Cook travels to Dallas to help a homeowner plant a garden using native species that are drought-tolerant; Roger uses expanded shale and compost to amend the clay soil; Tom Silva helps a homeowner replace a door with a picture window.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E22 Tile; Weatherstripping Contractor Angelo McRae explains to a homeowner how to lay out the tile, apply the thin-set and set the tile for a bathroom floor; Tom helps a homeowner add weatherstripping to her front door.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E23 Solar PPA; Framing Walls Ross Trethewey travels to San Francisco to learn about new ways to finance the installation of photovoltaic solar panels; Ross installs a new solar power system for a homeowner: Tom helps a homeowner frame the walls for a basement-remodeling project.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E24 Historic Windows; Filter General contractor Tom Silva heads to Alexandria, Virginia to restore the windows in a home built by George Washington; Richard installs a water filter at a kitchen sink.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E25 Generator; Clogged Sewer Host Kevin O'Connor and electrician Scott Caron travel to Annapolis, Md., to install a manual transfer switch for a portable generator; the guys ask What Is It?; Richard heads to Dallas to fix a sewer line that is clogged with tree roots.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S10 E26 Spray Paint; Wood Floor Roger Cook and Kevin refinish several worn-out items using spray paint; Richard Trethewey shows Kevin some new household devices that can be operated hands-free; Tom Silva removes wall-to-wall carpet and installs a pre-finished wood floor.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E10 Auburndale: Landscape Decisions and a Duck Tour Opening up the front yard and perennial beds; blending the old plaster work with the new; safely taking down a Norway maple; a tour of Boston's streets and a splash into the Charles River; removing paint from old shingles.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E11 Auburndale: Planning for the Pergola Setting footings for a pergola; giving a concrete stoop a makeover with fieldstone veneer risers and a bluestone cap; trimming out windows; vines at the Arnold Arboretum; using pitching sticks to create a mud job at the base of a new shower.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E12 Auburndale: Making the Most of Green Products New-generation composite decking made of recycled plastic and wood waste; a paint promises richer colors and low VOCs; what goes into a quality can of paint; updating the living room fireplace mantel's style to fit the newly renovated house.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E13 Auburndale: Absolute Curb Appeal Roger installs nine tons of rustic Pennsylvania fieldstone for the new entry walkway; kitchen island assembly; black and white tile scheme in the kids' bathroom; Norm boxes in the ceiling beams in the sunroom, finishing them off with crown molding.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E14 Auburndale: Front Yard Transformation Installing the pergola; Tom modifies the main staircase to better match the design details of the house; Roger preps the garden beds; a river birch tree arrives; Sue adds extra perennials to round out the garden; a new click-together laminate floor.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E15 Auburndale: Systems, Security and Surfaces Take Shape Wood island top with a distressed finish; installing his and hers closets; installing a wireless security system; high-efficiency two-stage air conditioning system; hot water system; installing a marble kitchen window stool and granite countertops.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E16 Auburndale: Transformation Complete! Finishing exterior low-voltage lighting; new composite shutters that add character; showing the hops vines planted to grow on the pergola; water-saving plumbing fixtures; the interior lighting plan, kitchen, master bedroom and bathroom are revealed.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E17 Los Angeles: TOH Goes Hollywood, Almost Expanding and renovating a 1933 Spanish colonial revival project house in the hillside neighborhood of Silver Lake while keeping its character; a major kitchen renovation; a second floor addition; reconfiguration of the back half of the first floor.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E18 Los Angeles: Only in LA A stop at a major Los Angeles movie studio; the back of a house has been demolished: no walls or roof remain; a facility where earthquakes are replicated to help develop ways to protect buildings from damage; heating and cooling systems.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E19 Los Angeles: Roof Tiles & Richard's Water Story Kevin arrives at the L.A. house to find the clay roof tiles on site as well as the custom windows and doors; strict California energy codes; the plan for the new roof; polypropylene underlayment; flashing details; stucco.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S32 E20 Los Angeles: Secrets of Silver Lake Norm wrestles with replicating the arch details from the living room in various openings in the house; the stucco system starts on the new addition with the scratch coat; Norm shows the formaldehyde-free batt insulation used in the basement.

classica.us.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
classica.us.description: Die von Carl Orff komponierten „Carmina Burana" sind in den Jahren 1935 und 1936 entstanden. Die Kantate basiert auf 24 Gedichten aus der gleichnamigen mittelalterlichen Sammlung, bestehend aus zumeist lateinischen Lied- und Dramentexten. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2020-01-01

classica.us.title: Cartoons in Concert
classica.us.description: Beliebte Figuren aus der Welt der Cartoons und Animationsfilme treffen im Konzertsaal auf eine mitreißende musikalische Fusion. Gemeinsam mit Chören und Orchestern des DR entsteht ein einzigartiges Konzerterlebnis. Seien Sie gespannt! (Special, Music, Concert) - 2024-12-24

classica.us.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C-Dur, Op. 17
classica.us.description: Nachdem er alle 32 Beethoven Klaviersonaten aufgenommen hat, um den 250. Geburtstag des Komponisten zu feiern, entschied sich der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwarz dazu, Soloklavierwerke von Robert Schumann aufzunehmen. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-11-28

classica.us.title: Tales of Two Cities: The Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
classica.us.description: Der Musik und Kultur der Kaffeehäuser des 18. Jahrhunderts in Leipzig und Damaskus wird mit Werken von Bach, Telemann und Händel, sowie mit klassischer arabischer Musik Tribut gezollt. Das Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra spielt in Toronto. (Special, Music, Classical)

classica.us.title: Brahms Tragische Ouvertüre & Mahler Sinfonie Nr. 1
classica.us.description: (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-10-11

classica.us.title: Clara Haskil - Das Geheimnis der Interpretin
classica.us.description: Für Freunde und Musiker war und ist die Schweizer Klaviervirtuosin Clara Haskil eine Interpretin, die wie keine andere Maßstäbe gesetzt hat. Anhand von Klaviereinspielungen, Briefen und Interviews zeigt der Film die Musikerin in neuem Licht. (Special, Documentary, Biography, Art) - 2017-08-27

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 4
classica.us.description: Gustav Mahlers Sinfonie Nr. 4, komponiert zwischen 1899 und 1901, schildert die kindliche Vorstellung vom Himmel, ein zentrales Thema, das den unschuldigen und lyrischen Charakter des Werkes prägt. (Special, Music) - 2026-02-28

classica.us.title: Rachmaninow - 1. Klavierkonzert,, Op. 1
classica.us.description: In diesem Konzert wird der Pianist Boris Berezovsky vom Moskauer Philharmonischen Orchester unter der Leitung von Alexander Sladkovsky in einer Aufführung von Rachmaninows Klavierkonzert begleitet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2021-07-09

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Schumann - Novelletten, op. 21
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz Schumanns Novelletten, Op. 21. Die acht Stücke für Klavier, die diesen Liederzyklus ausmachen, werden oft einzeln aufgeführt. Es trägt eine Widmung an den Pianisten Adolph Henselt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-01-23

classica.us.title: Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 und Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 7
classica.us.description: Iván Fischer dirigiert das Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in diesem Konzert. Eröffnet wird das Programm mit Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 in C-Dur, KV 338. Diese Sinfonie war die letzte, die Mozart in Salzburg als Hofmusiker schrieb. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-10-18

classica.us.title: Beethoven: Quintett für Klavier und Bläser, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Das Quintett für Klavier und Bläser in Es-Dur, Op. 16, von Ludwig van Beethoven wird im Auditorium Santa Cecilia in Perugia aufgeführt. Das Werk wurde 1796 vollendet und 1801 in zwei Fassungen mit Klavier und Bläsern oder Streichern veröffentlicht. (Music, Classical, Concert) - 2025-04-12

classica.us.title: The Unanswered Ives
classica.us.description: Charles Ives ist ein Mann der Dissonanzen - und das in fast allen Bereichen seines Lebens. Seit seiner Kindheit gilt seine Liebe dem Spiel mit der Musik. Doch Charles wurde zu einer Zeit geboren, als man klassische Musiker für Memmen hielt. (Special, Documentary) - 2019-09-22

classica.us.title: Schumann: Humoreske, Op. 20
classica.us.description: In der Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz die Humoreske in B-Dur, Op. 20. Schumann komponierte das Werk im Jahr 1839 und widmete es Julie von Webenau. Der Titel des Werks bezieht sich auf die ältere Bedeutung von Humor als emotionaler Zustand. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2023-12-19

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Mahler - Sinfonie Nr. 9
classica.us.description: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leitet das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino bei einer Aufführung von Gustav Mahlers Symphonie Nr. 9 in D-Dur. Diese Symphonie wurde in den Jahren 1908-1909 geschrieben und war die letzte, die Mahler vollendete. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-08-23

classica.us.title: In the Organ's Stomach
classica.us.description: Olivier Latry, der aktuelle Titularorganist der großen Orgel von Notre-Dame, führt die Zuschauer mit seinem Instrument auf eine Reise durch Landschaften, die Geschichte und unglaubliche Abenteuer, deren Zeuge das Instrument war. (Special, Music, Classical, Performing arts)

classica.us.title: Beethoven: Sinfonie Nr. 3 in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Gianandrea Noseda leitet das Orchester des Teatro alla Scala in Mailand. Auf dem Spielprogramm stehen Ludwig van Beethoven, Symphonie Nr. 3 Es-Dur op. 55. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2014-01-15

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - 2. Klavierkonzert, Op. 22
classica.us.description: Der Pianist Mikhail Pletnev wird vom Russischen Nationalorchester unter der Leitung von Kirill Karabits in einer Interpretation von Saint-Saëns' Klavierkonzert Nr. 2, op. 22 begleitet. Bei der Uraufführung 1868 dirigierte Anton Rubinstein. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2021-07-16

classica.us.title: Bach - 6. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Václav Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 6 in B-Dur, BWV 1051. Im Gegensatz zu den anderen Konzerten gibt es in diesem Stück keine Geigen. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-18

classica.us.title: Sol Gabetta auf dem Lucerne Festival 2018
classica.us.description: Die argentinische Cellistin Sol Gabetta kehrte 2018 zum Lucerne Festival zurück, um gemeinsam mit dem Mahler Chamber Orchestra unter der Leitung des Dirigenten François-Xavier Roth ein Konzert zu geben. (Special, Music, Event) - 2019-09-21

classica.us.title: Hollywood Gala
classica.us.description: Der Schweizer Dirigent Ludwig Wicki leitet das Dänische nationale Sinfonieorchester und den DR Junior Chor in einem glanzvollen Konzertprogramm mit Filmmusik. Das Programm umfasst eine Auswahl an Musik aus den besten und Oscar-ausgezeichneten Hollywood-Filmen wie Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart und Moulin Rouge, geschrieben von bedeutenden Komponisten wie John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner und Klaus Badelt. (Special, Music) - 2024-10-19
